The Court Made The Following:
 Order

This petition is filed by the petitioners-accused Nos.4 to 6 and 8 under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashing the charge sheet arising out of Crime No.45/2018 registered by Hiriyur Rural Police Station, Chitradurga and charge sheeted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 149 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of D.P. Act.

2. Heard the arguments of learned counsel for the petitioners and learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent No.1-State.
3.
Learned counsel for respondent No.2 remained absent.

4. The case of the prosecution is that on the complaint filed by respondent No.2, the Police registered the FIR and it is alleged by the complainant that she married accused No.1 Raghavendra (who is not the petitioner herein) on 12.05.2013 and later the marriage registration was held at Sub Registrar's NC: 2024:KHC:14906 Office on 28.05.2013.

At the time of marriage, the complainant's father had given Rs.50,000/- cash, gold chain weighing 20 grams, gold ring weighing 12 grams and a watch to the accused No.1 as dowry and also spent Rs.5,00,000/- as marriage expenses.

After marriage, as the accused No.1 was working in the military, he took the complainant to the military quarters situated at Ahmednagar at Maharashtra where they stayed and lead married life for 8 to 9 months.
Subsequently by saying that he was transferred to some other place, he left the complainant with his parents.

When she was residing with her parents in law, accused No.1 used to visit frequently and used to demand the complaint to bring further dowry of Rs.2,00,000/- from her parents house as his salary was not sufficient to lead married life.

Subsequently, accused No.5- Pavithra who is the sister of accused No.1 came for delivery and got delivered the child, at that time,
the other accused also used to come.

Accused Nos.2 and 3 along with accused Nos.4, 5, 6 and 8 were all continuously harassing the complainant physically and mentally by demanding further dowry and they thrown the complainant out of the house and told to bring additional dowry by saying that she should go back to her NC: 2024:KHC:14906 parents house or to her husband-accused No.1 and got locked the house and her in laws went to their daughter's house.

Subsequently, the accused persons not contacted her, therefore, the relative of the complainant approached the accused persons, they quarreled with the complainant and they abused in filthy language and also came to know that these accused persons colluded together and married the accused No.1 with one Shruthi and she also got a male child.
These accused persons also demanded Rs.2.00 lakhs as additional dowry.
Subsequently the other accused persons were continuously harassing her along with one Jayanna and he has stated that he will settle the issue.

Subsequently, they told the complainant to give divorce and they will pay Rs.15,50,000/- as permanent alimony and they also said to be paid Rs.1.00 lakh and also said that they will not pay any more and she can do whatever she wants.
Therefore, complaint came to be filed.

The Police took up the investigation and filed charge sheet,
which is under challenge.

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner has contended that there is no serious or specific allegation against these petitioners.
The main accused persons are not the NC: 2024:KHC:14906 petitioners before the Court.
There is no specific allegation against these petitioners.
They are residing in some other place, not with the accused Nos.1 and 2 or 3.
Therefore, continuing the proceedings against the petitioners is abuse of process of law.
Hence, prayed for quashing the same.

6. Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader seriously objected the petition and contended that there is specific allegation against all the accused persons and made out of the charge sheet and the statement of the witnesses.
The matter is required for trial and the Court cannot quash the criminal proceedings as they already got married the accused No.1 with one Shruthi and out of their wedlock, the child is also born.
These people all together committed the offence and thrown the complainant out of the house.
There is harassment met out by the complainant-victim in the hands of the accused persons.
Hence, prayed for dismissing the petition.

7. Having heard the arguments and on perusal of the records, which reveals, there is no dispute that the accused No.1 married this complainant and accused Nos.2 and 3 are the parents in law of the complainant.
Accused Nos.4 and 5 are NC: 2024:KHC:14906 the sisters of accused No.1 and accused Nos.6 and 8 are the husbands of the sisters of the accused No.1.
The complaint itself reveals that after eight months of their marriage, the accused No.1 brought the complainant/victim back to his parents house and left there.
Accused No.5-Pavithra younger sister came to the her parents house for delivery.

During that time, accused No.8 who is the husband of Pavithra and another sister Sujatha-accused No.4 and her husband accused No.6 were all continuously harassed the complainant and abused her in filthy language and they asked her to go out of the house and finally all these petitioners thrown out the complainant from the house and they locked it and went and stayed in J.J. Halli which is one of the house of the sister of accused No.1.
Subsequently, the complainant approached these accused persons, they quarreled and they abused in filthy language.

A specific word has been used by the accused has been mentioned in the complaint by respondent No.2 and also came to know that the accused No.1 already married one Shruthi without her consent and already having a child.

It cannot be said that these petitioners have no knowledge about the marriage of accused No.1 with Shruthi and these petitioners NC: 2024:KHC:14906 also demanded Rs.2 lakhs from the complainant to bring the same from her parents house and subsequently all accused persons together quarreled with the complainant and both have to give divorce and trying to settle by paying some permanent alimony and said to be paid Rs.1 lakh.
Thereafter, they refused to pay and all these petitioners told that she can take whatever action she wants.
The police investigated the matter.

There is various witnesses examined by the police and they have categorically stated that the overt act of these petitioners and the harassment meted out by the complainant in the hands of these petitioners.
There is specific allegation made against all the petitioners even though they are sisters and their husbands.
Therefore it cannot be compared that it is omnibus allegation or a general allegation against these petitioners.

These petitioners colluded,
quarreled and abused the complainant in filthy language and also it cannot be said that they do not have any knowledge regarding the second marriage of the accused No.1 with Shruthi.

Therefore,
whatever the defence available for facing the trial, this Court cannot conduct a mini trial for quashing the criminal proceedings.
Therefore, the petition is devoid of merits and liable to be dismissed.
